name: Unity: Melee, Ranged, Special attack
goalName: Implement a melee, ranged and a special attack
goal: In the Darkness Within, the character has the ability to do several attacks. The melee variant has a close range, but does more damage and is faster. The ranged attack does less damage and has a longer cooldown, but has a significantly larger range. The special attack is useful for damaging enemies surrounding the player, but has a huge cooldown.
